summary: 111, Inc. filed a 6-K with Exhibit 99.1 announcing second quarter 2026 unaudited results for the period ended June 30, 2026. Net revenue fell 28.3% year-over-year to RMB2.3 billion (US$339.0 million), reflecting the company's strategic transition to an asset-light model and prior divestitures of underperforming subsidiaries. Promotional-product revenue rose 121% to RMB60.7 million, and first-half marketplace service revenue grew 18.2%. Total operating expenses declined 16.1% to RMB155.5 million, aided by AI-agent adoption and workforce streamlining that generated substantial severance costs. This is a routine earnings release, not a discrete special situation.
